A07 instantiate packet 1 (verb offset 202, 100 lines) read whole with every cited concept quoted (d3_wq_A07_202_000/025/050/075.txt). G39 readings stated before any A07 line is written, changing no rule: (3) thanks or a cheer for a member's step, for one part, or for progress while the work is still being built is not the marking of a finished work, and a report that one part is finished is a build report (P03): so AmericanFlaginPlace-056 ('We filled in the blue. Good job'), aceattorney-038 and australia-059 show one end, while 2007scape-054 ('The letters have been complete!', then 'We did ti boys we have nice!') and cowchop-045 show the order; (4) a 'done' report carries the marking at once where G16 reads it so (a post, a collective 'we', an exclamation, 'on r/place'), while a plain reply stating the work made or showing its image, answered by a marking, is the mechanism in words (ReBoot-037 'Looks like it's a success', then 'We did it!!!'; TsundereSharks-044, Dorset-037, argentina-064, bangladesh-037); (5) a line whose reports all sit inside markings, with no separate report before the first marking, is J even where a bare cheer comes first (PUBATTLEGROUNDS-049, bostonbruins-048), and a line of bare cheers with no words on the work's state shows one end (AMD-049, MMA-052, Dustforce-030); (6) a work marked as done and then destroyed before the close was finished, since P11 does not require the work standing, so it shows the order (battlecats-050); D3a-13's family is for attempts never finished; (7) a member's own part told as hours or effort ('I spent all night on it') is P11's claim of a part, not a report of the work's state (cloud9-039)
